else:

# Create bioblend client
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance
gi = GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=api_key)

print(f'New history ID: {new_hist_id}')

# Note: history copy via bioblend
gi.histories.copy_content(seed_id, new_hist_id, 'all')
print(f'Content copied from {seed_id} to {new_hist_id}')

# List datasets in new history
contents = gi.histories.show_history(new_hist_id, contents=True)
for item in contents:
    print(f\"Dataset: {item.get('name')} (ID: {item['id']}, ext: {item.get('extension')})\")

# Download the CSV dataset
for item in contents:
    if item['name'] == 'Swarm_1.csv':
        dataset_id = item['id']
        gi.datasets.download_dataset(dataset_id, file_path='/workspace/Swarm_1.csv', use_default_filename=False)
        print(f'Downloaded Swarm_1.csv')
        break
"
